In this paper, we do not study the question of EA-equivalence of the (2m, t)-bent functions defined above. In general, this is a very difficult question. We only remark that Weng, Feng and Qui [23] proved that most of the PS type bent functions, obtained from a Desarguesian spread are not EA-equivalent to any Maiorana–McFarland bent function. This leads us to conclude that, typically, for t > 1, the (2m, t)-bent functions described by (9) are generally not EA-equivalent to the other two classes, as specified in (6) and (8).
